decision: For a stock managed-preedit client with no exact refresh, no initial snapshot AND no start witness, capture an expectation only for an exact already AuthorizedEdit from the whole live owned composition to a single word plus one Space. Require current context token, managed mode, supported preedit/surrounding, exact owned tail equal to composition, end cursor, non-sensitive/unsealed/non-atomic state. The expectation is the emitted text as the ENTIRE hypothetical field. It is not an observed empty-field witness and grants no pre-dispatch edit or learning authority. Existing known-start expectations still require their unchanged complete field prefix; a stale or partial known witness never falls back. Reuse existing exact final-Space-to-NBSP acknowledgement with owner/epoch/deadline/caret/selection gates and existing ManualToggleV3/VisibleTailV4 verification. Ordinary UserInput and all output routes unchanged.
